pytest_isolation_contract: DATABASE_URL absent from the environment; DATABASE_PATH points to an isolated database outside the repository
launcher_isolation_contract: DATABASE_URL points to an isolated database outside the repository; DATABASE_PATH alone does not safely isolate every launcher process because .env may already supply DATABASE_URL
guard_preference: first preference: --verify automatically creates and uses a fresh temporary DATABASE_URL and removes it after verification
final_design: new scripts/verify_launcher.py runs before any migration/API startup
if DATABASE_URL is set in the process environment: effective target is validated via load_settings; empty or resolving to the development database / any database inside data/ refuses before startup

if DATABASE_URL is not set in the process environment: a fresh temporary database is auto-provisioned outside the repository, DATABASE_URL is set for all verification subprocesses, and the temporary database is removed in a finally block
a DATABASE_PATH-only environment can never silently fall back to the development database during verification
normal non-verify launcher behavior remains unchanged
guard_rules_met: resolve the effective database target before any write-capable action
effective database can never be data/writing_feedback.db, an equivalent resolved path, a database inside data/, or a silent fallback to the development database
DATABASE_PATH-only environment cannot fall back to the development database
unsafe explicit resolution fails before any database connection or write
failure output explains the isolation contract without exposing secrets
